text:
marta_gonzalez: FYI customer ACME reported that some subprojects in their org went to 0 credits around the monthly rollover while others refilled fine. They see 'zero' for about 10-40 minutes staggered across subprojects. :thinking: they supplied tenant IDs and timezone (CET).

samir_patel: can you paste the tenant_id(s) and the exact local times they observed? also cc @billing-bot so logs can be pulled.

marta_gonzalez: tenant org: acme-corp, subprojects: acme-corp/frontend (proj_773), acme-corp/backend (proj_774). Customer saw frontend hit 0 at 2026-03-01 00:00 CET, backend stayed functional and then hit 0 at 00:28 CET. Attached their screenshots.

jinwoo_choi: quick hypothesis: our monthly reset runs per-project using the org's configured reset hour but the worker picks the timezone from the project's metadata if present. there was a migration last quarter that left some projects with explicit tz and others inherited 'UTC' marker. that could explain staggered behavior. grabbing reset job logs now.

billing-bot: pulled job logs for org acme-corp between 2026-03-01T22:55:00Z and 2026-03-01T23:40:00Z. Found reset events:
```
2026-03-01T23:00:05Z reset proj_773 -> set monthly_bucket = monthly_alloc
2026-03-01T23:28:12Z reset proj_774 -> set monthly_bucket = monthly_alloc
```
Note: system cron runs on UTC midnight boundary by default. Projects with tz=CET had an offset applied earlier by worker.

olivia_ng: interesting — so this is not a UI cache issue, it's the reset worker scheduling. do we have customers complaining about streaming sessions being cut when a subproject refills while another is still zero? might explain some outage reports.

marta_gonzalez: yes customer mentioned long-running streaming clients to frontend got 429s then recovered when backend refilled. they regarded it as unpredictable.

jinwoo_choi: reproduction steps I ran locally: created two projects under same org, set one project metadata.tz = 'Europe/Paris' and left the other unset (defaults to UTC). ran monthly_reset_worker against both. observed resets applied at different UTC ticks consistent with offset calculation. snippet of the problematic code: 
```
// monthly_reset_worker.js
const tz = project.metadata.tz || org.default_tz || 'UTC';
const resetMoment = moment.tz(`${year}-${month}-01 00:00`, tz);
// then convert to UTC tick when enqueuing
```
The bug: when metadata.tz is missing we fall back to org.default_tz *but* some older projects still have metadata.tz=null and worker used 'UTC' unexpectedly.

samir_patel: thanks. what customer-facing impact and P0 risk?

olivia_ng: impact is mid severity: intermittent 429s for some subprojects around rollover window, confusion for billing because tickets say "credits vanished then came back". not full outage but affects realtime apps. P1.

marta_gonzalez: recommended immediate mitigation for support: ask customers to restart long-lived streams after rollover, and we'll push a quick UI refresh toggle to surface per-project reset_time so they can see offsets.

jinwoo_choi: engineering fix: patch worker to canonicalize tz to org.default_tz when project metadata.tz is null and add a migration to backfill unset metadata.tz entries to org.default_tz. also add a shadow-run test for rollover parity across all subprojects in an org. planning PR.

samir_patel: notify affected customers and offer credits if they suffered failed requests. marta can you prepare a short support blurb?

marta_gonzalez: drafting message now: "we found a scheduling inconsistency that caused staggered monthly resets across subprojects under some orgs. engineers are patching the reset worker and will backfill timezone metadata. as a workaround, restart any long-lived streaming sessions after the monthly rollover. we can offer usage credits for any verified lost requests." will send once reviewed.

jinwoo_choi: timeline: will cut a hotfix to normalize tz fallback today and run migration in next 48h. will also add monitoring to surface >5m variance in reset times between sibling projects.

olivia_ng: thanks team. tagging for followup: @samir_patel for credits decision, @jinwoo_choi for PR, @marta_gonzalez for customer comms. :thumbsup:

marta_gonzalez: sending comms to ACME now and attaching repro logs. closing loop here once hotfix merged. thanks!"
